purpose: Measure the existing 961-entry implementation before another section is admitted.

reading.scope: Node retained heap delta after GC; excludes browser/iPhone qualification and transient peak allocation

search.scope: Node retained heap delta after GC; excludes browser/iPhone qualification and transient peak allocation

assessment: These after-GC Node measurements keep the configured four-book cache bounded. They do not measure browser transient peaks or qualify an iPhone; no performance rewrite is justified by this baseline alone.
